title: ‘त्यो एउटा कुरा’ नाट्यकृतिमा विसंगतिवादी नाट्यशिल्पको प्रयोग
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख नाटककार धु्रवचन्द्र गौतमको ‘त्यो एउटा कुरा’ नाट्यकृतिमा प्रयुक्त नाट्यशिल्पको वैशिष्ट्य निरूपणमा केन्द्रित छ । कुनै पनि नाट्यकृतिमा प्रयुक्त शिल्पको अध्ययन विभित्र दृष्टिकोणले गर्न सकिन्छ तापनि प्रस्तुत नाट्यकृतिमा जीवनजगत् सुन्दर, सुखद, सङ्गतिमूलक र काम्य छ भत्रे आशावादी एवं आदर्शवादी नाट्यमान्यता र शिल्पपद्धतिका विपरीत जीवनजगत् विद्रूप, त्रासद, निःसार अस्तित्वहीन छ भत्रे विसङ्गतिवादी जीवनदृष्टिलाई अभिव्यक्ति दिन कथ्य, कथानक, पात्र, परिवेश, संवाद आदि नाट्यतत्त्वको चयनमा पनि विसङ्गतिवादी शिल्पपद्धति अवलम्बन गरिएको छ । तसर्थ यस अध्ययनमा विसङ्गतिवादी नाट्यमान्यता र शिल्पपद्धतिका आधारमा प्रस्तुत नाट्यकृतिको शिल्प वैशिष्ट्यको अध्ययन गरिएको छ । प्रस्तुत नाट्यकृतिलाई शुद्ध पाठ्यविधा मानेर साहित्यका सामान्य तत्त्वका आधारमा अध्ययनविश्लेषण भएको भए तापनि श्रव्यदृश्यकाव्यका रूपमा विङ्गतिवादी नाट्यमान्यता र शिल्पपद्धतिका आधारमा विशिष्टकृत अध्ययन भएको पाइँदैन । त्यसैले यो अध्ययन महत्त्वपूर्ण रहेको छ । प्रस्तुत अध्ययन गुणात्मक पद्धतिमा आधारित छ । सामग्रीको विश्लेषण व्याख्यात्मक तथा विवेचनात्मक विधिमा गरिएको छ । जीवन सुखद, सङ्गतिपूर्ण, सारपूर्ण, सुन्दर र कमनीय छ भत्रे देखाउन नाट्यत्त्वको चयन गरी नाटक रचना गर्ने परम्परागत नाट्यमान्यता र नाट्यशिल्पका असहमतिमा जीवनको विद्रूपता, अर्थहीनता र निःसारता चित्रित हुने गरी नाट्यतत्त्वको सुविचारित छनोट र चयनपद्धति नै प्रस्तुत नाट्यकृतिको रचनाप्रक्रियाको व्याकरणसूत्र बनेको छ भत्रे यस अध्ययनको निष्कर्ष रहेको छ । विषयपरिचयआधा दर्जनबढी नाट्यकृतिका स्रष्टा धु्रवचन्द्र गौतम विसङ्गतिवादी नाट्यमान्यता र शिल्पपद्धतिका सफल प्रयोक्ता हुन् । प्रस्तुत लेख उनकै ‘त्यो एउटा कुरा’ नाट्यकृतिमा प्रयुक्त विसङ्गतिवादी शिल्पवैशिष्ट्यको निरूपणमा केन्द्रित छ । समकालीन युगसन्दर्भमा परम्परागत नाट्यमान्यता र शिल्पपद्धतिहरूको औचित्यमाथि प्रश्न उठाउँदै अभिनव मान्यता र शिल्पसौन्दर्यका उत्तमोत्तम सम्भावनाहरूको सन्धान ‘प्रयोग’ हो भने प्रयोगको नैरन्तर्य प्रयोगशीलता हो र प्रयोग हुनुको भाव र धर्म प्रयोगधर्मिता हो । पाश्चात्य साहित्य जगत्मा यथार्थवादोत्तर युगमा भएका आन्दोलनहरूमध्येको विसङ्गतिवादी मान्यता पनि एउटा प्रयोगधर्मी मान्यता हो । यसले जीवनजगत् सुसङ्गत, सुन्दर र सारपूर्ण छ भत्रे आशावादी–आदर्शवादी मान्यताका विपरीत जीवनजगत् विसङ्गत, त्रासद, दुर्बोध्य र अस्तित्वहीन छ भने कलासाहित्य त्यही विसङ्गत जीवनको अभिव्यक्ति हो भत्रे मान्यतालाई मुखरित गर्छ । त्यही मान्यताका आधारमा विसङ्गतिवादी नाट्यरचनाप्रक्रियामा पनि विसङ्गत शिल्प अँगालिन्छ । धु्रवचन्द्र गौतम पनि प्रयोगधर्मी नाटककार हुन् । प्रस्तुत लेख गौतमले ‘त्यो एउटा कुरा’ नाट्यकृतिमा पनि प्रयोगधर्मी विसङ्गतिवादी नाट्यशिल्पपद्धतिको प्रयोग गरेका छन् ; त्यो प्रयोगका मौलिक विशेषता के हुन् र प्रस्तुत नाट्यकृतिमा केकस्तो प्रयोगधर्मी शिल्प प्रतिफलित भएको छ भत्रे प्राज्ञिक जिज्ञासाको निरूपणसँग सम्बन्धित छ । अध्ययन परम्परामा केही विद्वान्हरूले उक्त नाट्यकृतिलाई साहित्यिक विधासरह सामान्य अध्ययन गरेको पाइन्छ तर विसङ्गतिवादी मान्यता र शिल्पपद्धतिलाई नै मुख्य आधार बनाई नाटक मूलतः श्रव्यदृश्य काव्य हो र यसको अध्ययन रङ्गमञ्चीय प्रस्तुतिप्रदर्शनको पक्षसँग जोडेर प्रस्तुत नाट्यकृतिको शिल्पपद्धतिको वैशिष्ट्यको विशिष्ट अध्ययन गरेको पाइँदैन । यस सन्दर्भमा यो अध्ययन औचित्यपूर्ण ठहर्छ ।
american_english: This article focuses on delineating the characteristics of the dramatic craft employed in playwright Dhruva Chandra Gautam's dramatic work "Tyo Euta Kura." While the craft employed in any dramatic work can be studied from various perspectives, in the present dramatic work, contrary to the optimistic and idealistic dramatic conventions and craft methodologies that hold the world to be beautiful, pleasant, harmonious, and desirable, the absurdist craft methodology has also been adopted in the selection of dramatic elements such as theme, plot, characters, setting, dialogue, etc., in order to express the absurdist worldview that the world is grotesque, tragic, meaningless, and devoid of existence. Therefore, this study examines the craft characteristics of the present dramatic work based on absurdist dramatic conventions and craft methodologies. Although the present dramatic work has been analyzed and studied as a pure textual genre on the basis of the general elements of literature, a specialized study based on absurdist dramatic conventions and craft methodologies, treating it as audio-visual poetry, has not been found. Hence, this study is significant. The present study is based on a qualitative methodology. The analysis of materials has been carried out through interpretive and discursive methods. The conclusion of this study is that, in disagreement with the traditional dramatic conventions and dramaturgy that create drama by selecting dramatic elements to show life as pleasant, harmonious, meaningful, beautiful, and lovely, the deliberate selection and screening of dramatic elements that depict life's grotesqueness, meaninglessness, and emptiness constitute the grammatical formula of the creative process of the present dramatic work. By way of introduction, Dhruva Chandra Gautam, creator of more than half a dozen dramatic works, is a successful practitioner of absurdist dramatic conventions and craft methodologies. This article focuses on delineating the craft characteristics of the absurdist approach employed in his dramatic work "Tyo Euta Kura." In the contemporary context, questioning the propriety of traditional dramatic conventions and craft methodologies, the search for the best possibilities of innovative conventions and craft aesthetics is "experiment"; the continuity of experiment is "experimentalism"; and the spirit and ethos of experimenting is "experimentalism." In the Western literary world, the absurdist convention among the movements of the post-realist era is also an experimental convention. It articulates the convention that, contrary to the optimistic-idealistic convention that holds the world to be coherent, beautiful, and meaningful, the world is absurd, tragic, incomprehensible, and devoid of existence, and that art and literature are the expression of that very absurd life. On the basis of that very convention, the absurdist craft is also embraced in the absurdist dramatic creative process. Dhruva Chandra Gautam is also an experimental playwright. This article is concerned with the intellectual curiosity regarding what the fundamental characteristics of that experiment are and what kind of experimental craft is reflected in the present dramatic work, as Gautam has also employed an experimental absurdist dramatic craft methodology in "Tyo Euta Kura." In the research tradition, some scholars have been found to have studied the said dramatic work as a general literary genre study, but a specialized study of the craft methodology of the present dramatic work, taking absurdist conventions and craft methodologies as the main foundation and linking the study of drama as fundamentally audio-visual poetry with the aspect of stage presentation, has not been found. In this context, this study is justified.

informal_english: This article zeroes in on the dramatic craft in playwright Dhruva Chandra Gautam's play "Tyo Euta Kura." Sure, you can study the craft in any play from all sorts of angles, but in this play, instead of the usual optimistic, idealistic take that says the world is beautiful, pleasant, harmonious and desirable, they've gone with an absurdist craft approach, picking themes, plots, characters, settings, dialogue and all that, to express the absurdist worldview that the world is grotesque, tragic, meaningless and devoid of existence. So this study looks at the craft in "Tyo Euta Kura" through the lens of absurdist dramatic conventions and methods. Even though the play's been analyzed as a straight-up text using general literary elements, nobody's done a specialized study treating it as audio-visual poetry through an absurdist lens. That's what makes this study matter. It's a qualitative study. Materials were analyzed using interpretive and discursive methods. The bottom line: unlike traditional dramatic conventions that pick dramatic elements to show life as pleasant, harmonious, meaningful, beautiful and lovely, this play deliberately selects and screens elements to depict life's grotesqueness, meaninglessness and emptiness, and that's the structural DNA of the play's creative process. By way of intro, Dhruva Chandra Gautam, who's written more than half a dozen plays, is a pro at absurdist dramatic conventions and methods. This article digs into the absurdist craft characteristics in his "Tyo Euta Kura." In today's context, questioning traditional dramatic conventions and methods, the hunt for the best possibilities of innovative conventions and craft aesthetics is "experiment"; the continuity of experiment is "experimentalism"; and the spirit and ethos of experimenting is "experimentalism." In the Western lit world, the absurdist convention among post-realist movements is also an experimental convention. It puts forward the idea that, contrary to the optimistic-idealistic view that the world is coherent, beautiful and meaningful, the world is absurd, tragic, incomprehensible and devoid of existence, and that art and literature express that very absurd life. Building on that, the absurdist craft gets embraced in the absurdist creative process too. Gautam's also an experimental playwright. This article tackles the intellectual curiosity about what the fundamental characteristics of that experiment are and what kind of experimental craft shows up in the play, since Gautam's used an experimental absurdist dramatic craft method in "Tyo Euta Kura." In the research tradition, some scholars have studied the play as a general lit genre study, but a specialized study of the play's craft method, taking absurdist conventions and methods as the main foundation and tying the study of drama as fundamentally audio-visual poetry to stage presentation, hasn't been found. In this context, this study is justified.
